content.text:
The drawing shows a benzil skeleton: two carbonyl carbons joined to each other, with a phenyl ring on one and a 4-nitrophenyl ring on the other.

- The left ring carries NO2 at the para position, written in the image as O2N.
- The nitro group is neutral as drawn, so I wrote it in the charge-separated form [N+](=O)[O-].
- The central unit is C(=O)C(=O), with each carbonyl carbon bonded to one aromatic ring.
- There are no wedges, hashes or double-bond geometry to encode, so the SMILES has no stereochemistry.

SMILES: O=C(c1ccccc1)C(=O)c1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-]
